svg.title: Alexandre Pais: the isle of Avalon
svg.desc: Live pixel-art scene. It is day in Lisbon (12:52), overcast, 15°C. The rune wall shows 113 contributions in the last year. 19 public repositories, 9 followers, 589 visitors, level 5. Inventory: Unity, C#, C, Java, Python, SQL, JavaScript, PHP, Scala, HTML, CSS, MySQL, Linux, Docker, Node-RED, Xcode, Git, VS Code, Databricks, Azure, Fabric, Power BI, SharePoint, MongoDB, Redis, Confluence, GitHub. The guardian says: GREY SKIES OVER LISBON, 15°C. THE GULLS STAY HOME. 2 NEW RUNES CARVED TODAY. THE BEACON BURNS BRIGHT. WELCOME, TRAVELLER! 589 HAVE VISITED AVALON BEFORE YOU.
